choices.D: No, because he is not qualified under Section 800, CMTA

220.question: The maximum amount of home appliances but one of a kind that an OFW may bring in as a returning resident duty and tax exempt.

225.question: Machineries, equipment, tools for production, plans to convert mineral ores into saleable form, spare parts, supplies, materials, accessories, explosives, chemicals, and transportation and communications facilities imported by and for the use of new mines and old mines which resume operations may enter conditionally free when certified to as such by which of the following?

choices.D: Importer is required to mark the imported goods prior to release from customs custody.
